description.long:
Plan smarter trips with AI-generated itineraries.

Timbuktoo creates personalized, day-by-day travel plans based on your interests—food, experiences, pace, and budget—so you can explore destinations with clarity and confidence.

FEATURES
• Personalized travel itineraries
• City recommendations based on preferences
• Restaurants, attractions, and local highlights
• Day-by-day plans with weather context
• Feedback and reporting tools

AI TRANSPARENCY
Some content is generated using artificial intelligence. AI-generated recommendations are informational only and may be inaccurate or incomplete.

PRIVACY
Your data is used only to personalize recommendations. You can request deletion at any time.

reviewNotes.instructions: Login with demo credentials. Accept AI disclosure on onboarding screen 2. Generate an itinerary (takes 30-60 seconds - this is expected). Feedback tools are enabled.
reviewNotes.additionalNotes: AI-generated content is disclosed during onboarding (mandatory consent checkbox) and within the app (AI banner on every itinerary). Demo account is on FREE tier to demonstrate paywall. Use Sandbox Tester to test in-app purchases.
